[ITST.5.5.3] **Per-area `build_engine` helper.** Each
test file has a private `build_engine()` (or
equivalent) that handles boilerplate. After ≥2 areas
need the same helper, lift to `spec_common.h` (for
spec tests) or a shared impl-test helper header
(for impl tests). Don't lift before — premature
abstraction across areas with diverging needs is
worse than one copy per file.
